title: Alphabetical menus, quest colours and pages that remember where you were
items: Pages remember where you were: leave a page and come back, and it opens at the same spot instead of the top. Each character remembers its own spots, and they're kept if the page reloads. Opening a link to a card still takes you straight to that card.
Editing notes: #links stay coloured while you type, and clicking into a note puts the cursor where you clicked without the page jumping. This works in game notes, quest notes, logs and descriptions.

Drop-down menus are in alphabetical order: races, classes, item types, where items are, NPCs, locations, factions, religions, quests, fonts, borders, backgrounds, special abilities, bonus types and the rest. Choices like None or — stay at the top, and Other… and Upload… stay at the bottom.
Menus that are a scale keep their natural order: rarity, attitude, how you feel about someone, size, alignment, quest status, +1 to +5 and other numbers, and the Sort by choices.
# menus list their categories (Factions, Key items, Locations, Maps, NPCs, Players, Religions) and every name in alphabetical order. A leading "The" is ignored when sorting.

Quests are coloured by status: Active blue, On hold grey, Completed green and Failed red. The colour is a light tint with a stripe down the left side, and all text stays easy to read in light and dark mode.
Quests has moved into Notes, after Game Notes. Its number in the menu counts active quests.

Item pictures can be adjusted like NPC pictures: drag to choose what shows and zoom in. Use Adjust in the picture's view, from the Items page or the Gear box. Pictures that aren't square open Adjust straight after uploading, and item pictures are now kept at a higher quality so zooming stays sharp.

title: More item icons, Gear cards and UI scale
items: Items page: each item is a full-width box again, with a small picture. Click the picture to see it bigger and to upload, change or reset it.

Over 50 item icons: swords, daggers, axes, maces, hammers, flails, spears, polearms, bows, crossbows, slings and staffs; arrows, bolts and bullets; armor, shields, helms, gloves, boots, cloaks, belts and bracers; potions, scrolls, wands, rods, rings, amulets, books, gems, rope, lanterns, food, tools and more. Each item gets one from its name.
Platinum, gold, silver and copper coins next to the Money boxes.

Gear box (Full): each slot is a card with the item's picture, rarity and icon on its top-left corner. Empty slots show a faint icon for what goes there. Gear box (Compact) shows the icons next to the names.
Options → Customise: UI scale makes everything bigger or smaller on this device (75% to 150%).
Quests: type # in Quest giver, Location, Reward or an objective to pick an NPC, location or other name. Linked names show underneath and open their pages.
Long damage text (for example a bow with flaming arrows) now fits in its box.
Typed-in weapons and armor such as "Heavy mace" or "Heavy steel shield" are recognised as weapons and armor.

title: Item pictures, icons and rarity
items: Items page has Full and Compact views. Full shows each item as a card with a picture; Compact shows one line per item with its main button (Drink, Use, Wield, Equip). Click a name in Compact to open it in Full view.
Every item has a picture: a stand-in for now, or Upload picture to use your own (Change and Reset afterwards).

Type icons (weapon, armor & shield, ammunition, potion & oil, scroll, wand / staff / rod, ring & wondrous, gear, treasure) sit on each item's top-left corner, coloured by rarity. They also show in the Potions & oils box on Combat & Effects.
Rarity: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Very rare, Legendary and Artifact. It's guessed from the item's price until you choose one, and each item's type can be changed too.
+1 to +5 weapons and armor are recognised as weapons and armor, and priced by the 3.5 rules for sorting by value.

title: Key Items and merging double-ups
items: Key Items page under Notes for artifacts, quest items, clues, letters and keys: type, status (we have it, seen it, heard of it, lost, handed over, destroyed), who has it, where it is, the quest it belongs to, powers and properties, and what you've learned. NPCs and locations show the key items they hold, #item links them in notes, and they can be pinned on maps.

Merge with… on every NPC, player, location, faction and religion card joins two cards for the same thing (a misspelling, a nickname or a name learned later). Pick which name to keep, or type the correct one.

Nothing is lost when merging: descriptions are combined, empty details and stats filled in, logs joined, and links, temples, map pins and initiative entries move to the kept card. The old name is changed to the kept one in every note, quest and card.
Cards show a hint when another one has a very similar name, with a Merge button.
Join… on Game notes and Quests adds another note or quest into this one (quest objectives are combined without repeats).
Every merge can be undone straight after.

title: Religions, mentions and healing choices
items: Religions page under Notes: gods, faiths and cults with title, alignment, domains, portfolio, holy symbol, favored weapon, worshippers, temples (linked locations), allied and rival faiths, and what you've learned. NPCs and factions have a Faith field, and #rel links religions in notes.
Mentioned in: every NPC, player, location, faction, religion and map lists the notes, quests and cards that name it. Click one to jump straight there (Game notes scroll to the note).
Renaming an NPC, player, location, faction, religion or map changes the name everywhere it was written, so links keep working.
Potions & oils box on Combat & Effects (Full and Compact).
Healing potions, healing items and cure spells ask how to heal: Roll for me, or roll your own dice and type the total. Choose who's healed (you, a companion or someone else). Cancel spends nothing.
Experience: type the XP you gained and Add XP adds it to your total, with Undo for the last one and a note when you're ready to level up.
Items page: Sort by type, where it is, name, weight or value, with a colour for each kind of item.
Game notes search fixed and improved: matches every word in any order across title, date and text, highlights matches and shows how many notes match.

title: Painted backgrounds for every theme
items: Painted backgrounds for every class and race theme and Old parchment.
Options → Customise: Background now lists None, every painted background (use any of them with any theme) and Upload background for your own picture.
Box opacity slider: choose how much of the background shows through the boxes. Text colours adjust so everything stays easy to read at every setting.
Your own background pictures now show at full strength with see-through boxes, like the painted ones.

title: Updates and Paladin background
items: Updates: Options shows this version and whether a newer one is out, with an Update button and this change log.
Painted background for the Paladin theme. Bright pictures are dimmed a little in dark mode so text stays easy to read.

title: See-through boxes
items: Painted backgrounds show through the boxes, top bar and menu, with text kept easy to read.
Full-width top bar and tidier page tabs.

title: Rogue background
items: Painted background for the Rogue theme: a moonlit city.

title: Save location and Mac app
items: Save location: keep your characters, homebrew and pictures in a folder of your choice (NAS, Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud Drive) and share them between computers. Windows and Mac apps, and Chrome or Edge on a computer.
Mac app: one download for Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

title: Specialist wizards
items: Specialist wizards: choose a specialty school for the extra spell slot, and prohibited schools.
Magic Missile and Scorching Ray show and roll the right number of missiles or rays for your caster level.

title: Themes
items: Options page with a theme for each character: 20 presets by class and race, your own colours, fonts, borders, title styles, backgrounds and textures.
Adventure layout: an original scene for every class and race, framed boxes and a shield-shaped Armor Class.
Colours are checked automatically so text stays readable in light and dark mode.

title: Combat & Effects
items: Combat & Effects page: every box full width with Full and Compact views.
Attack options (flanking, sneak attack, Power Attack, Rapid Shot, Point Blank Shot and more) and attacks of opportunity that reset each round.
Initiative: a spells and conditions menu for every combatant, who each effect is on, and name suggestions when adding.
Companions as Full/Compact/Hide boxes, shown on Combat & Effects when they're in initiative.
Spells show damage type, dice at your caster level, touch attacks and saves; prepared spells can be limited to your slots.
Magic and custom ammunition, item labels on the Items page, and picture framing for NPCs, players, places and companions.

title: New look
items: Start screen: Continue, New Character, Load Character and Options.
Sidebar menu, and a round box that shows who is up now and next.
Rounded look, Full/Compact/Hide panels on the Character sheet, and a Long rest button.

title: Character Codex
items: The multi-ruleset Character Codex, started from the 3.5 Character Codex: rulesets chosen when a character is made, homebrew by ruleset, and a sheet you can rearrange.
